title: Build the operating model before the headcount.
body: Taking over R&D infrastructure, I defined the org structure, hiring bar, and operating model first. Then I grew a 5-person team into a 24-engineer global organization of FTEs, contractors, and managed-service providers.

title: Reliability is a team habit, not a hero move.
body: I set SLOs, built on-call rotations, and made blameless postmortems routine. Incident readiness rose from 40% to 75%, and the team delivered 382 deployments on its own.

title: Spend like an owner.
body: I ran a competitive multi-vendor RFP, renegotiated contracts across 1,000+ lab environments, and restructured Tier 2 support. Capacity and cost governance continued after the savings landed.

title: Shared ownership beats escalation.
body: A long-running incident-response conflict ended when I brokered a shared-ownership charter across network, network-security, and infra-security teams. It drove 162 production changes and 40+ VLAN migrations.
